summary: Advance your career with expert E-waste management training. Learn R2v3, WEEE compliance, ITAD security, and urban mining. Enroll to drive circularity today.
lede: E-waste management training helps environmental, IT asset, sustainability and supply-chain professionals plan safer recovery and responsible handling of discarded electronics. Participants learn to assess hazardous materials, design take-back programs and track material flows, while applying secure handling practices to data-bearing devices and auditing downstream recycling partners.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is designed for professionals responsible for the lifecycle of electrical and electronic equipment within corporate, industrial, or regulatory environments.
modules: Global E-Waste Landscape and Regulatory Frameworks
Material Composition and Hazardous Substance Management
Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) and Take-Back Strategies
IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) and Data Security
Collection Systems and Material Flow Analysis (MFA)
Advanced Recycling Technologies and Urban Mining
Transboundary Movement and Basel Convention Compliance
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in environmental management, IT operations, or supply chain logistics. Basic familiarity with waste management terminology and corporate sustainability reporting is recommended. No prior engineering background is required.
